mapper.select: SELECT a.gid as id, sum(m.H001A)as totemple FROM ovie_web.economico_mza m, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom) GROUP BY a.gid
SELECT trunc (avg(ide),2)as indsoc FROM ovie_web.economico_mza m , ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ide > 0 AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom)

SELECT estr_poc AS estrato, round((cnt * 100.00) / sum(cnt) OVER (), 0) AS porcentaje FROM ( SELECT d.estr_poc, count(*) AS cnt FROM ovie_web.denue d JOIN ovie_web.areas a ON a.gid = #{id} WHERE ST_Intersects(a.the_geom, d.the_geom) GROUP BY d.estr_poc ) s ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) total, COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.desc_cort), ''), left(d.desc_scian, 100)) AS desc, COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.cve_scian), ''), LPAD(d.codigo_act::text, 6, '0')) AS cve_scian FROM ovie_web.denue d, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,d.the_geom) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.cve_scian), ''), LPAD(d.codigo_act::text, 6, '0')), COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.desc_cort), ''), left(d.desc_scian, 100)) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

WITH clave AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.cve_scian), ''), LPAD(d.codigo_act::text, 6, '0'))::numeric AS scian, COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.desc_cort), ''), left(d.desc_scian, 100)) AS desc_cort FROM ovie_web.denue d JOIN ovie_web.areas a ON a.gid = #{id} WHERE ST_Intersects(a.the_geom, d.the_geom) ), directo AS ( SELECT count(*) AS n, max(desc_cort) AS desc_cort FROM clave WHERE scian = #{cve} ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT n FROM directo) > 0 THEN (SELECT n FROM directo) ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM clave WHERE scian IN (SELECT scian FROM ovie_web.cadenas_productivas WHERE clv_act = #{cve})) END AS count, COALESCE( (SELECT desc_cort FROM ovie_web.cadenas_productivas_pal WHERE clv_act = #{cve} LIMIT 1), (SELECT desc_cort FROM directo), (SELECT nombre_corto FROM ovie_web.scian_2013_vw WHERE scian::numeric = #{cve} LIMIT 1) ) AS desc_cort

SELECT count(*) FROM ovie_web.denue d, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,d.the_geom) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.sector), ''), substring(LPAD(d.codigo_act::text, 6, '0'), 1, 2)) IN ('43', '46')

SELECT count(*) FROM ovie_web.denue d, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,d.the_geom) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.sector), ''), substring(LPAD(d.codigo_act::text, 6, '0'), 1, 2)) IN ('48', '49', '51', '52', '53', '54', '55', '56', '61', '62', '71', '72', '81', '93')

SELECT count(*) FROM ovie_web.denue d, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,d.the_geom) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.sector), ''), substring(LPAD(d.codigo_act::text, 6, '0'), 1, 2)) IN ('21', '22', '23', '31', '32', '33')

SELECT sum(po_c) as comercio ,sum(po_i) as industria ,sum(po_s) as servicio, sum(po_t) as total FROM ovie_web.sectores_mza m, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom)

SELECT sum(va_c) as comercio ,sum(va_i) as industria ,sum(va_s) as servicio, sum(va_t) as total FROM ovie_web.sectores_mza m, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom)
SELECT (sum(m.a111a)/sum(m.h001a))*1000 as pl FROM ovie_web.economico_mza m, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom)
SELECT trunc(((sum(m.J000A::numeric)/sum(m.H010A::numeric))*1000)/12,2) as reprom FROM ovie_web.economico_mza m, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom)
SELECT sum(m.po_t)as totemple FROM ovie_web.economico_mza m, ovie_web.areas a WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,m.the_geom)
SELECT nombre_corto FROM ovie_web.scian_2013_vw WHERE scian::numeric=#{id}
SELECT ponderador FROM ovie_web.ponderador WHERE gid=1
